params.caption: Tasavvur qiling: yangi guruhdagi birinchi dars, hamma jim o'tiribdi. Keyin kimdir kulib "So, who else is a bit nervous?" deydi va xonadagi noqulay sukunat birdan yo'qoladi. Ingliz tilida buni break the ice deyishadi: notanish odamlar orasidagi tortinchoqlikni yo'qotib, suhbatni boshlab yubormoq. A short game at the start of the lesson helped us break the ice. He told a funny story to break the ice. Asking about someone's hobbies is an easy way to break the ice. Shu iboradan icebreaker degan so'z ham chiqqan, ya'ni tanishish uchun beriladigan qisqa savol yoki o'yin: Let's start with a quick icebreaker.
